items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is reported as $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage is $890.42 across 4,892 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost periods do not align; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs are incomplete; monthly budget limits are blank; and no learning-outcome threshold exists. Treat traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, AI usage, and pilot output as non-financial or non-causal metrics. Continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation using recorded telemetry; retain all new growth and monetization work as deferred backlog.
